item.title: Fire Apparatus Rolls Onto Its Side in WI
item.description: The driver of the Lake Country (WI) Fire and Rescue apparatus was the only person inside and was not injured. The post Fire Apparatus Rolls Onto Its Side in WI appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: IN Pumper Struck from Behind at Accident Scene
item.description: While the crew was wrapping up the accident and getting the last patient ready for transport, a third vehicle crashed into the back of the engine, causing significant damage. item.title: E-Bike Rider, 65, Dies in Crash With Ambulance in Brooklyn (NY)
item.description: Lynwood Wilkerson, 65, died in a collision with an NYU Langone Hospital ambulance in Brooklyn. The ambulance crew was responding to a call and was not cited, police said. The post E-Bike Rider, 65, Dies in Crash With Ambulance in Brooklyn (NY) appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Department Improves Response Times as It Restores, Expands Resources
item.description: The Long Beach (CA) Fire Department has improved citywide emergency response times by 30 seconds through enhanced resources, including a full-time paramedic unit and staffing adjustments. item.title: MA Town Says Goodbye to Historic Fire Station
item.description: Building committee members and firefighters swung sledgehammers in a ceremonial gesture, taking turns striking the interior walls of the structure that has served the department for roughly 60 years. item.title: Provincetown (MA) FD Apparatus Crashes Into Utility Pole
item.description: A Provincetown (MA) Fire Department engine crashed into a utility pole while returning from a medical emergency. No injuries were reported, and the cause is under investigation. item.title: Ford to Donate Darley-Equipped Broncos to Search and Rescue Teams
